prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Katy, Texas. Injury: wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1049; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Katy, Texas, waiting for a gap in oncoming traffic, when a vehicle coming straight through the intersection struck the driver's side of my car. The impact spun my vehicle partway around and I felt a sharp pain in my left wrist as I braced against the steering wheel. Paramedics checked me at the scene and I was taken to hospital, where X-rays confirmed a fractured wrist. I have described the collision the same way to the officer at the scene, to the medical staff, and to the insurer each time I was asked, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the household member of the policyholder and live at the same address, and I drive the vehicle regularly with their permission. I am submitting this statement so the claim can be assessed under the coverage that applies to members of the household.
